Name: Lantana Lagoon Music for PolyamorySweet
Author: circlejourney
Description:
Adds original music ("Flowers on the Breeze") to the Lantana Lagoon map in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url], a polyamory mod by ApryllForever. Music is by me - I did my best to capture its romantic seaside atmosphere!

[youtube]EUr26wYTlxE[/youtube]

Simply download and add to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. You can make the music loop by editing the content.json file, replace [code]"Looped": false[/code] with [code]"Looped": true[/code].
